name: KyberSwap Elastic
summary: A double-rounding edge case let the swap result price pass a tick boundary while the Pool logic treated the tick as uncrossed, leaving currentTick inconsistent with base liquidity and enabling an overpaying reverse swap.
notes: KyberSwap Elastic factory CREATE2 deployment of the direct immutable Pool runtime; deployment-block and pre-exploit runtime hashes match.

KyberSwap reports $55,234,535.17 taken from affected pools across the multi-chain exploit campaign: $48,671,786.84 by the primary exploiter and $6,562,748.33 by mimicking bots, valued at exploit time. This gross figure precedes later recoveries and excludes assets that were temporarily inaccessible rather than stolen.
The official gross campaign loss is aggregated across chains, affected pools, and exploiters; its published asset table is not allocated to individual exploit transactions or pool targets.
Not the knot: sibling instance of the same template and failure; target-5 carries the latest age reset and supplies the incident's single observation.
